name: Official HEB export
notes: Official app exports 156 main parameter words plus 192 extended/CAN words into a 696-byte file.

name: Worthless HEB export

conflicts.summary: Worthless copies raw logical addresses 0-155 rather than the official compact ranges 0-53/99-110/124-213; its extended block is also zero-filled. Equal 696-byte length does not imply backup compatibility.

notes: Managed C0205fk.java:163-179 and ll0.java:1524-1525 connect native raw words to export. Native emulator confirms logical address 99 is raw index 99, not HEB compact offset 54.

name: GDriver HEB backup
notes: 696 bytes; 156 compact main words from ranges [0,54), [99,111), [124,214), plus 192 configuration words. Restore has separate hardware-specific CRC/options; unsupported Hermes output leaves some helpers empty.
